name: Facilitating Families Counseling
defaultDescription: Facilitating Families Counseling, LLC. Telehealth therapy for eating disorders, couples and family, individual support, and trauma.
telehealthLine: All sessions are held virtually by telehealth.
privacyLine: All text messages and emails are securely encrypted.
crisisLine: If you are in crisis or thinking about suicide, call or text 988 (Suicide & Crisis Lifeline), available 24/7. If you are in immediate danger, call 911.
